alertsSection.title: Price Alerts

alertsSection.intro: Shows up in the notification bar once price or RSI(14) crosses the threshold you set — the app checks in the background roughly every 5 minutes; this is an in-app alert, not an email/push notification.

technicals.title: Technical Indicators

performance.title: Period Performance
performance.intro: Return from the start of the selected period to today, based on closing price.

compare.title: Asset Comparison
compare.intro: Compare up to {{max}} assets side by side: price, risk/return metrics, technical indicators, and period performance. Sharing the link opens the same comparison for the other side too.
compare.maxSelected: Up to {{max}} assets can be selected
compare.selectAtLeastTwo: Select at least two assets above to compare.
compare.normalizedIntro: Each asset's price at the start of the selected period is normalized to 100 — a pure return comparison, independent of absolute price differences.
